assertions.name: binding_energies_match_ame2020_table
assertions.source: Route A: Σ m_constituents − m_nucleus from CODATA-2022 nuclear masses, as computed here. Route B: ame_binding_mev(Z, A), the AME2020 quoted binding-energy-per-nucleon × A. Expected = the nuclide list rebuilt from the rows the scan actually uses.

assertions.name: scan_scored_every_observable_normalizer_pair
assertions.source: Route A: the pair counter incremented only after the coefficient is computed. Route B: len(candidates) × len(z_basis) rebuilt from the input lists. The NULL below is only worth its coverage, so these must agree.

assertions.name: no_observable_normalizes_to_half_h2_within_0p5pct
assertions.source: Route A: the 0.5%-gate match list from this run's scan. Route B: the NULL recorded in audit 2026-06-01 §3 (Task 3 of PR #1617). Falsifiable in the direction that matters: a new hit fails it.

description: Task 3 of PR #1617: search for physical observables that exhibit +0.5·h² (the Yekutieli natural-reading H_4 partition quantity) at their h² coefficient. Tests deuteron/⁴He/³He/tritium binding energies, multi-nucleon non-additive residuals, isospin mirror residuals under various natural normalizations.

data.verdict: NULL — none of 5 candidate observables (deuteron/⁴He/³He/T binding, multi-nucleon residuals, isospin mirrors) normalizes to +0.5·h² under 13 natural normalizers. The Yekutieli +0.5 may be a STRUCTURAL quantity without a corresponding L2 observable — common for partition-combinatoric quantities.

caveats: m_He3_MeV and m_He4_MeV are hand-typed here at 5–6 dp rather than read from the CODATA/AME registry, which is why B(³He) and B(⁴He) sit ~5e-5 MeV from AME2020 while B(d) and B(T) — built from registry masses — agree to <5e-7 MeV. Recorded, not repaired; the binding_energies_match_ame2020_table bound is set wide enough to carry it and tight enough to catch a real error.
